findings.opportunity: ChangeDerivedViewCard (lines 179-224) and CandidateViewCard (lines 226-271) are byte-identical in all 46 body lines except the component signature and the navigate() search object; a normalized diff shows no other differences. The duplicated markup (Card props, Valid/Invalid badge, ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED count badges, ERROR diagnostics list, 'No semantic graph changes' text) must be maintained in two places and can drift. The three SimpleGrid sections (Views, Candidate, Active Changes) also repeat the identical 6-prop grid config.
findings.impact: Removes ~46 duplicated lines plus the three identical grid configs; badge/diagnostic/count presentation has a single source of truth; a future change (e.g., a new diagnostic level, count badge style, or empty-state wording) touches one component instead of two.
evidence: single-index.tsx:179-224 vs 226-271: normalized diff produces exactly 2 differing lines (signature and search object); every other line is identical
single-index.tsx:181-182 vs 227-228: identical `const counts = source.diff?.summary` / `const hasIssues = source.diagnostics.some(d => d.level === 'ERROR')`

single-index.tsx:205-219 vs 251-265: identical Badge colors/order (+green, ~yellow, -red), ERROR diagnostic Text (size xs, red, lineClamp 2, key by index), 'No semantic graph changes' condition `!hasIssues && counts && counts.total === 0`
single-index.tsx:82-90, 94-102, 108-116: identical SimpleGrid props (p, pt, cols base:1/sm:2/md:3/xl:4, spacing, verticalSpacing)
findings.recommendation: Extract one `SourceCard` component taking `source: Pick<XirangViewSource, 'label' | 'valid' | 'diagnostics' | 'diff'>` and a `search` builder callback for navigate(); render it from both the candidateSources and changes maps with their respective search lambdas. Optionally extract the shared grid config into a small `CardGrid` wrapper used by all three sections. Both cards' navigate semantics and rendered DOM stay exactly as today.
findings.keyDesign: `function SourceCard({ source, search }: { source: Pick<XirangViewSource, 'label'|'valid'|'diagnostics'|'diff'>, search: (previous: RouteSearch) => RouteSearch })` computes `counts = source.diff?.summary`, `errorDiagnostics = source.diagnostics.filter(d => d.level === 'ERROR')` and `hasIssues = errorDiagnostics.length > 0` once, then renders the single Card body; click handler stays `e.preventDefault(); void navigate({ to: '/view/$viewId/', params: { viewId: 'model' }, search })`. Usages: `{candidateSources.map(s => <SourceCard key={s.id} source={s} search={prev => ({ ...prev, view: s.id })} />)}` and `{changes.map(c => <SourceCard key={c.change} source={c} search={prev => ({ ...prev, view: 'model', change: c.change, mode: 'diff-only' })} />)}`. `XirangChangeSource extends Omit<XirangViewSource, 'id'|'source'>` structurally satisfies the Pick, so no type exports or context changes are needed.
preservationConstraints: Candidate card navigation MUST remain `{ ...previous, view: source.id }` with no change/mode keys (e2e 'reviews candidate changes in diff only mode' asserts `view=candidate-diff` and no 'Full context' toggle; 'browses the complete candidate model' asserts `view=candidate`)

Change card navigation MUST remain `{ ...previous, view: 'model', change: source.change, mode: 'diff-only' }` (e2e 'opens an active change from the landing page' asserts URL contains `change=browser-change` and `mode=diff-only`)
Card keys: candidate cards `s.id`, change cards `c.change`

Rendered DOM/text must stay identical: Card props (shadow xs, padding lg, radius sm, className group, withBorder, component a, href `/view/model/`, cursor pointer), 'Valid'/'Invalid' badge colors, count badge order/colors, ERROR diagnostics size xs red lineClamp 2 keyed by index, 'No semantic graph changes' only when `!hasIssues && counts && counts.total === 0`

Section visibility conditions unchanged: Candidate section when `candidateSources.length > 0`, Active Changes section when `changes.length > 0`; section headings 'Candidate' / 'Active Changes' and their text sizes unchanged (e2e `getByText('Active Changes')`, `getByText('browser-change', { exact: true })`)
No changes to ContractLoaderContext.tsx, playwright.config.ts, or the e2e spec; the `changes` context channel and `manifestToSources` stay as-is
implementationOutline: Add `SourceCard({ source, search })` whose body is the exact current ChangeDerivedViewCard body, with `errorDiagnostics`/`hasIssues` computed from one filter pass
Replace `ChangeDerivedViewCard` usage with `search={prev => ({ ...prev, view: 'model', change: c.change, mode: 'diff-only' })}`
Replace `CandidateViewCard` usage with `search={prev => ({ ...prev, view: s.id })}`; delete both old components
Optionally extract `CardGrid` wrapping the shared SimpleGrid props and use it in all three sections (Views, Candidate, Active Changes)
Run the C5 build/typecheck and the e2e spec on desktop + mobile to prove zero behavioral delta
validation: `pnpm exec playwright test test/e2e/semantic-browser-candidate-views.spec.ts --project=desktop --project=mobile` — proves 'shows candidate cards on the landing page', 'keeps invalid candidate sources diagnosable', 'opens an active change from the landing page', 'browses the complete candidate model', 'reviews candidate changes in diff only mode' still pass (URL search params, text selectors, card rendering, diff-only projection)

`cd likec4 && pnpm --filter @likec4/spa typecheck` (or the C5 sequence `pnpm --filter @likec4/spa build && pnpm --filter xirang-likec4 build`) — proves the shared component accepts both XirangViewSource and XirangChangeSource structurally
